acceptance: Two branches that each archive comment history into different pages merge with no conflict in docs/history/code-comments/README.md
The index a reader sees still lists every page with its entry count
fix: Stop tracking the generated index rows. Either generate the index at read time (a docs build step or an `evolve comments history index` verb), or register a git merge driver that re-runs writeHistoryIndex. A page that two branches append to also needs a union merge (`merge=union` in .gitattributes) for its appended sections.
summary: Every comment-zero branch rewrites the generated table in docs/history/code-comments/README.md and appends a section to shared pages such as internal-core.md. On 2026-10-16, each of seven branches conflicted with the others there, and main's index was found stale by two counts after an earlier hand-merge. The landing needed a scratch rebuild script and a train.
title: The generated comment-history index conflicts on every parallel merge
